    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(SwerveModuleAcceleration other)
      Compares two swerve module accelerations. One swerve module is "greater" than the other if its acceleration magnitude is higher than the other.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<SwerveModuleAcceleration>
      Parameters:
      other - The other swerve module.
      Returns:
      1 if this is greater, 0 if both are equal, -1 if other is greater.
